common_environment: gas phase unless an entry is explicitly excluded from the common score

requirements: unconstrained optimization from every preregistered linear and T-shaped seed
harmonic Hessian for every converged stationary point
retain all distinct harmonic minima, not only the lowest one
do not add a target-specific rescue geometry after seeing results

real_space_force_stage.wavefunction_density_source: same r2SCAN-3c stationary-point calculation unless a replacement method is frozen for the full panel before any result
raw_outputs_required: electron-density critical-point connectivity if QTAIM is run
rho and laplacian at every reported bond critical point
local stretching force constants or equivalent raw Hessian-derived interaction measures when available
real_space_force_stage.reason: v0.10 forbids converting one QTAIM BCP or one arbitrary numeric threshold directly into a topology label

required_before_execution: one implementation for all four targets

comparisons: linear activated XY2 candidate versus all retained weak-complex/isomer minima of the same stoichiometry
XY2 versus X + Y2 whole-pair dissociation
record energy and ZPE consistently under one method policy

literature_reference_status.NeCl2: external primary literature supports VDW reference class
literature_reference_status.NeBr2: external primary literature supports VDW reference class
literature_reference_status.ArBr2: external primary literature supports VDW reference class

anti_fit_rules: No new diagnostic family may be added to v0.10 after target-specific results are visible.
No single QTAIM BCP, canonical MO diagram, bond order, or optimized formula can resolve the topology by itself.
If a common analysis implementation cannot be applied to one target, that family is NOT_RUN/INCONCLUSIVE for that target rather than replaced by a bespoke method.
Environment-specific high-pressure results are not mixed into the gas-phase score.
All raw outputs used to make a family verdict must be preserved with provenance.
